notes.title: Update Information (October 15th, 2020)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38885408/1ec8563ddb3234d676ce69f03437281ba5fbd3b3.jpg[/img]

Thank you for playing "Onee Chanbara ORIGIN".
We apologize for causing you any trouble while playing.
The bug which "Language setting is return to Japanese by restart the game" is fixed today.
We are continuing to find out what cause the bugs happened, and fix it as soon as possible we can. 
Thank you very much.
